main_text.head: LIBRI II.
main_text.l: An victus opponi debeat intemperiei æquali gradu contrariæ qualitatis. 620.
A quibus sumatur quando exhibere cibum febricitantibus debemus. 626.
Eorum quæ de ptisana Hippocrates scripsit nonnulla sunt aliis cibariis communia & aliqua ptisanæ peculiaria. 641.
Vbi mulsa, vbi oxymelite vtendum sit. 644.
A quibus ratio potus qui ægrotantibus ministrandus sit sumatur. 647.
Quod Lusitani medici & Hispani methodum Hippocratis in administratione victus non insequantur. 685.
Minoratiuam euacuationem quæ per pharmacum fit non esse semper administrandam in initiis febrium putrida- rum. 688.
Qui inter initia morborum tenui magis victu vtuntur, cum que prope statum peruentum est, solidori, in damnum æ- grotantium graviter peccant. 698.
Victus rationem quam medici Angli observant præceptis artis medicæ magis consentire. 701.
Anglis ægrotantibus no esse tenuem victum offerendum, sumpta indicatione à consuetudine, regione, & cæli te- pere. 703.

page.notes: Printed page numbers in the entries are kept as printed. "no" in the entry for CAP. XVII. and "pere" at its line end are as printed; "Anglos" at the foot is a right-aligned word, possibly a catchword or stray marker, and is transcribed as seen. Some entries are doubtful at the line ends, with hyphens kept as printed.
